items.title: Corpay’s (NYSE:CPAY) Q3 2026 sales beat estimates
items.summary: Business payments company Corpay (NYSE:CPAY) reported Q3 2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with revenue up 17.9% year on year to $1.38 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $5.35 billion at the midpoint came in 0.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $7.54 per share was 4.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
